description: Land Title Settlement Department  -  Moratumulla, Moratuwa D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No.  520202 and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels in various locations. It contains detailed land parcel numbers, ownership details, property boundaries, and encumbrances - all characteristic of land-related administrative matters falling under Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
